subject: math
description: Solve a bearing-based route problem, represent it on a coordinate map, and transform the route using coordinate rules.
learningObjectives: Translate bearing descriptions into accurate route diagrams
Use oblique-triangle reasoning to solve missing distances or angles in a navigation context
Plot route points on the Cartesian plane using coordinates
Apply translation, reflection, and rotation rules to a mapped route
Explain how bearing evidence and coordinate rules support a final route map
prerequisites: Right, acute, and obtuse angle vocabulary
Law of Sines and Law of Cosines basics
Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
Coordinate rules for translations, reflections, and rotations
